parameters.query: INSERT INTO clients (client_code, company_name, domain, contact_email, contact_name, plan_type, status, config, api_key, webhook_secret, max_contacts, max_keywords, max_emails_per_month, onboarded_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.client_code }}', '{{ $json.company_name }}', '{{ $json.domain || '' }}', '{{ $json.contact_email }}', '{{ $json.contact_name || '' }}', '{{ $json.plan_type }}', 'onboarding', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.config) }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.api_key }}', '{{ $json.webhook_secret }}', {{ $json.max_contacts }}, {{ $json.max_keywords }}, {{ $json.max_emails_per_month }}, NOW()) RETURNING *

parameters.subject: Welcome to GreeVo - Your API Credentials
parameters.content:
Welcome to GreeVo, {{ $json.contact_name || $json.company_name }}!

Your account has been set up successfully. Here are your credentials:

  • Client Code: {{ $json.client_code }}
  • API Key: {{ $json.api_key }}
  • Webhook Secret: {{ $json.webhook_secret }}
  • Plan: {{ $json.plan_type }}

Webhook Endpoint

Send contacts to: POST {{ $env.N8N_HOST }}/webhook/contact-sync

Include header: X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY

Limits

  • Max Contacts: {{ $json.max_contacts }}
  • Max Keywords: {{ $json.max_keywords }}
  • Max Emails/Month: {{ $json.max_emails_per_month }}

Our team will reach out shortly to complete the setup.
